🚨 a heron that isn't quite there when you look at it, the creek went still, and your arm-hairs stood up, a drumbeat with no drummer, getting closer, a gold flash in the grass, gone when you look is at Haven's door. The village looks to you. Four ways to call: a RUNNER (slow, dangerous), a SIGNAL FIRE (fast, loud, everyone sees), the SYSTEM RELAY (if it can carry voices), or an ABILITY CRY (if your build has one). Each with honest costs.
🎁 "We watched your first week! You're good at... let us see..." (A gift awaits — choose an ability.)
⬢ SYSTEM: "Neural depth 20. I can hold more of you now — ability slots: 2."
🎁 "OH! You can hold more now! We've been HOLDING this — take it, take it, take it!" (The System's gift awaits — choose an ability.)

◈ THE SPARK — something clicks. A trick Chen learned long ago suddenly has edges it never had. SYSTEM: "ANOMALY: organic unit demonstrates pattern recognition. Slot capacity increased. We are taking notes." (Ability slots: 2)
◈ CRISIS — THE SIEGE. They came in the night for the pantry — and the village met them at the door with blades and fire and drove them back into the dark. Wealth has a scent. So does defiance.
SYSTEM: "INTRUDER REPELLED. The pantry’s aroma is now classified as a defensive liability. The audience is chanting the defenders’ names. Fan clubs are forming. This is how it starts."

✨ Ability gained: Green Thumb, Literally (L1). Gather 50% more food from plants. Ask the Plants reveals what grows in the area, once a day. Cultivate growing Haven beds: 200 kcal, once per bed each day. Higher levels accelerate growth further.

◈ FLASHBACK — Contract Quill
It has signed three leases, two loans, and one terrible contract you still regret. The penmanship was always excellent. The judgment, less so.

◈ FLASHBACK — Dad's Thermos
Dad tapped it twice before the first sip, every morning, like knocking before entering the day. You do it too now. Some mornings it's the only conversation you have.

◈ "UNIT ENERGY BAR WRAPPER — [TRANSLATION COMPLETE] — we have been watching you carry this. Attachment waveform: significant. Function decoded: +resolve when worn (morale). You knew it mattered before we did. Cute."

◈ FLASHBACK — Energy Bar Wrapper
Empty. You used to read the nutrition label when you missed numbers — calories, protein, the math of staying alive. Funny, the math that matters now.

◈ FLASHBACK — Grandfather's Rope
The summer the oak came down across the driveway, Grandfather showed you the trucker's hitch and made you tie it until your fingers bled. You were eight. The tree moved.

abilities.desc: Your lucky rock. The System finds your faith adorable and helps a little: +5% on the hunt. (It’s not the rock. It’s you believing in the rock.)

abilities.name: Third Eye
abilities.desc: A small eye opens on your forehead when danger is near. +30% ambush detection. It weeps when you lie.
